1989: Every day follows the same order: understand the explanation and its examples, build by hand, memorize the day's terms, read from the sources, and finish with a short quiz. The next day opens when you finish your tasks and get 60% of the questions right. Day six is review, a project and a weekly test.
1996: A 24-week (6-month) journey from zero to professional: two hours a day, 6 days a week. Every day has an explanation, hands-on practice, terms, reading and a short quiz, and every week ends with a project and a test you must pass with 70% to open the next week. Along the way: JavaScript, Python, SQL, Docker and AI, until you deliver projects to clients and run them in production.
2004: Your progress is saved in the browser. If you create an account with your email, it's saved online and you can continue on any device.
